key_insight: PMC-PaIR uses citation-linked case reports and question-guided language models to build a large dataset of clinically similar medical image pairs for retrieval research.
clinical_relevance: Retrieving images with similar clinical findings could support diagnosis, teaching and research, but this study does not establish clinical benefit.
method: Follow citations linking potentially similar patient case reports.
Generate and answer hierarchical questions about modality, diagnosis and findings, then match images using their captions.
Fine-tune BiomedCLIP on the resulting image pairs and evaluate retrieval.
evidence_signal: PMC-PaIR contains 86,144 image pairs from 56,013 case reports; experts judged pairs highly accurate, question-guided matching yielded twice as many correct pairs as direct matching, and fine-tuning improved retrieval across all tested categories.
watch_item: Case reports often feature rare or challenging presentations, so performance may not generalize to routine clinical image collections.
paper_title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
